justification: `jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/FileSystemView.java` is 743 lines long and defines 22 public members, while combining several distinct responsibilities: path lookup/resolution (`toRealPath`, `isSameFile`), directory-stream creation (`newDirectoryStream`), file creation (`createDirectory`, `createSymbolicLink`, `getOrCreateRegularFile`), link/delete/copy/move operations, and attribute read/write APIs. That breadth of operations in one class is strong evidence of insufficient modularization.
